configurePresets.name: vs2019
configurePresets.description: Builds the library and bundled codecs with VS2019 tools. Requires Visual Studio 2019 with the v142 C++ tools installed.

configurePresets.name: vs2022-v142
configurePresets.displayName: Visual Studio 2022 with VS2019 tools (v142, x64)
configurePresets.description: Produces v142 binaries using VS2022 as the build host. Install the optional MSVC v142 - VS 2019 C++ x64/x86 build tools component first.

configurePresets.name: vs2022
configurePresets.description: Generates a Visual Studio 2022 solution under build-vs2022/

configurePresets.name: vs2026
configurePresets.description: Generates a Visual Studio 2026 solution under build-vs2026/. Needs CMake 4.2+ and a Visual Studio 2026 install.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc
configurePresets.description: Builds with cl.exe via Ninja under build-ninja-msvc/ - run from a Developer Command Prompt/PowerShell (or after vcvarsall.bat) so cl.exe is on PATH.

configurePresets.name: vs2022-all
configurePresets.description: Generates a portable CMake-backed solution with Win32, x64, ARM64, ARM64EC and All Platforms under build-vs2022-all/visualstudio/.

configurePresets.name: vs2026-all
configurePresets.description: Generates a portable CMake-backed solution with Win32, x64, ARM64, ARM64EC and All Platforms under build-vs2026-all/visualstudio/.
